findings.summary: The `groupCommentsIntoBatches` function completely ignores hunk and symbol locality grouping, instead arbitrarily chunking all same-file comments into batches of five.
findings.suggested_fix: Update `groupCommentsIntoBatches` signature to accept a diff snapshot or pre-parsed hunks/symbols. Use `parseUnifiedDiff` and `findHunkForLine` from `unified-diff.ts` to group comments only if they overlap the same parsed hunk/symbol, and fall back to the batch cap only when locality cannot be derived.

findings.summary: The tests under the 'comments in one hunk form one stable batch' describe block do not actually assert hunk locality, merely testing same-file grouping.
findings.suggested_fix: Mock or pass actual diff snapshot/hunk data into the batcher and write test cases verifying that comments in different hunks within the same file are isolated into separate batches.
